match: disputes at risk of sla breach
prompt: Show disputes at risk of SLA breach in the next 24 logical hours.

results.text:
SLA risk rose from **1** to **13** disputes, and **$7,197.75** of disputed value is now due within the next 24 logical hours. Amounts are normalized to US dollars.

- PAID_BY_OTHER_MEANS in queue_disputes_escalated accounts for **12** of the 13 at-risk disputes and **$7,022.94** of the value at risk.
- Open disputes rose from **5** to **25**; all 20 new ones carry PAID_BY_OTHER_MEANS.

One reason code in one queue explains almost all of the near-term risk. Ask which merchant those disputes trace to before deciding whether this is one incident.

sql.command:
SELECT queue_id, reason_code, SUM(open_dispute_count) AS open_dispute_count, SUM(sla_risk_count) AS sla_risk_count, SUM(sla_risk_amount_total) AS sla_risk_amount_total
FROM aa_dispute_sla_risk
GROUP BY queue_id, reason_code
ORDER BY sla_risk_count DESC, sla_risk_amount_total DESC
